components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid var(--brand); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--surface); background: var(--brand); font: 600 14px var(--font-ui); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-strong); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bordered, quiet action that does not compete with the primary task.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); font: 600 13px var(--font-ui); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--input-line); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A continuous 72px research query surface containing strength and submit actions.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; min-height: 72px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 22px; border: 1px solid var(--input-line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--surface); align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; font: 400 16px var(--font-ui); } .ds-search button { min-height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; color: var(--surface); background: var(--brand); font-weight: 600; } .ds-search:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Scholight is a generous research surface with a small number of precise instruments and no ornament competing with the work. Flat surfaces, thin dividers, one blue accent, and restrained motion carry one system from public search into authenticated account tools.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous editorial reading flow instead of repeated result cards.
Restrained blue used for actions, selection, and meaningful emphasis only.
Flat layout with hairline separation; elevation is reserved for temporary surfaces.
Short, low-amplitude motion that communicates state and respects reduced motion.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Literata names and frames the work; Manrope operates it.

rules.name: The Temporary Elevation Rule
rules.body: If a surface remains in document flow, it does not receive a shadow.

dos: Do use shared semantic tokens for every color, type role, radius, elevation, and motion duration.
Do keep result pages continuous and optimized for scanning and reading.
Do keep motion between 90ms and 280ms, under 6px of travel, and limited to feedback or continuity.
donts: Don't imitate AnySearch or another search product's layout, branding, or interaction vocabulary.
Don't use generic AI-tool marketing, gradients, agent hype, invented capabilities, or retrieval implementation jargon.
Don't build card-heavy SaaS dashboards or split papers into repeated elevated containers.
Don't add bouncing controls, parallax, animated counters, large slides, or decorative choreography.
